note: Frames picked from two read-only scans of 2026-09-30 for M5.F (B-14), anonymous and direct: one socket attached the channels of the 100 most watched live rooms of the JP, TW and HK recommendations for 45 minutes (15:21 to 16:06 UTC), another those of the next 150 for 60 minutes (15:55 to 16:55 UTC); each sent only ATTACH frames and kept only the frames of stream ends, barrages and liveinfo.mute changes. Each line has its room (the channel); t is the time since the start of its scan. Kept: the only paid barrage seen (barrageStyle, barrage type 1 ノーマル, point 79, backgroundColor #B3F518CC); barrages that fly as well but cost no coins: from the sender's stock, types 14 (count 148) and 12 (count 34), an army line (type 5, isInfinite) and a streamer assistant's line (type 4, 場控彈幕, isInfinite); two stream ends (LIVE_STREAM_END, closeBy normalEnd); in the room 29802206 the start of a mute (a LIVE of liveinfo type 0 with mute true and every figure 0), two viewers' comments written while it lasted (78 s) and its end (type 0, mute false). Users scrubbed as in S08-resume (the streamer of the army line too, also in its text).
